note: The place of each model of World in the showcase of Bãi Trước (plan 0026, D3). "front" is the middle of the front of the model (x and z of the game), "facing" the direction that its front looks to (x and z), and "front_middle_x" the x of that point in the model, "box" the box of the model in its own frame (x from, x to, z from, z to; the front is at z = 0), "street" the street that the front looks to (a model of World has its front at z = 0 and looks to +z in Godot). The model stands on the ground at its front. "ranges" gives the end of the near, the mid, and the far level for each preset (D6: on Low the near level of a building is its mid level, so the near level has no range). The sources of each place are with it. tools/geo/build.py makes the ground level under the box of each model, at the height of the ground at its front (plan 0009, R8).
